purpose: Authoritative read contract for chat-first Mournreach play. Optimize persistence without rereading the entire campaign.
authorityOrder: active entity sheets and their memory/knowledge ledgers

everyTurn.why: active beat, scene entities, due off-screen simulations, and exact files to hydrate

hydrateWhenRelevant.trigger: NPC is present, directly acted upon, making an off-screen move, or its memory/knowledge can change outcome
major quest progression, reveal gating, act transition, or fail-forward routing
location/region changes, lore is tested, travel is resolved, or world-law interaction occurs
first relevance or visual needs rendering
NPC level-up, decision, memory write, relationship shift, or off-screen tick

doNotDo: Do not scan the full repository every turn.
Do not load every NPC sheet when only one or two can affect the scene.
Do not reread the full hidden campaign spine for ordinary dialogue or movement.
Do not let narration invent a durable fact without writing it to authoritative state.
Do not let an image override text canon; images are visual references, not rules text.
turnProtocol: Hydrate only IDs listed as active/relevant/due.
Apply validated consequences to player, entities, clock, quests, inventory, factions and memories.
Run due off-screen NPC ticks only when world time/event cadence requires them.
Persist changed files to campaign-data before presenting the completed turn.

performanceRules.npcSheetCache: Reuse already-read sheet in the same response; refetch on later turns only when active or due.
performanceRules.storySpine: Use beat IDs from runtime-index. Hydrate full spine only around progression/reveal checks.
performanceRules.worldBible: Hydrate on location/lore/world-law triggers, not routine scene dialogue.
performanceRules.visuals: Resolve via assets.json; generate new art only on first relevance or a canonical visual-state change.
performanceRules.offscreenCadence: Tick inactive NPCs on meaningful elapsed time, milestones, regional events, or scheduled plans—not every conversational turn.
